title: Content Fields: Links, Rich Text, Markdown and YouTube Videos

chapters.title: Links, Rich Text, Markdown and YouTube
chapters.subtitle: Four fields for addresses, formatted text and video

steps.text: A content type can hold more than text and numbers. In this video we'll add a Link Field, an Html Field, a Markdown Field, and a Youtube Field to a content type, fill them in, and see the result on the site.
Text, numbers and dates don't cover everything. A workshop page needs a sign-up link, a formatted schedule, a list of things to bring, and a teaser video.
A Link Field stores an address, the text of the link, and where the link opens. An Html Field stores formatted text, such as a schedule.
A Markdown Field stores text written in Markdown, such as a list. A Youtube Field stores the address of a video, and shows it in a player.
The Link Field, the Html Field, and the Youtube Field come with the Content Fields module. The Markdown Field comes with the Markdown module. You enable both under Tools, Features.

chapters.title: Link Field
chapters.subtitle: An address, link text and a target

steps.text: Content types are under Design, Content Definition, Content Types. Select Edit on the Workshop type, which already has a Title. Its Fields section is empty, so select Add Field.
Enter Registration Link as the Display Name, and the Technical Name follows from it. Under Field Type, choose Link Field.
Select Save & Configure. The field is added, and its settings open.
Required makes the address mandatory. The Text drop-down decides what the link says. Choose Text is required, so every link has words that people can read.
Default value of the Target fills the Target box in each new item. Enter the value that opens the link in a new window or tab, and then select Save.

chapters.title: Html Field
chapters.subtitle: Formatted text with the Wysiwyg editor

steps.text: Select Add Field again. Enter Schedule as the Display Name, choose Html Field, and select Save & Configure.
Hint is help text that appears under the field in the editor. Sanitize Html is on by default, and it removes unsafe markup when the content is displayed.
The Standard editor is for people who write HTML markup. The Wysiwyg editor shows formatted text with a toolbar. Choose Wysiwyg editor from the drop-down, and select Save.

chapters.title: Markdown Field
chapters.subtitle: Plain text that becomes formatted text

steps.text: Add one more field. Enter What to Bring as the Display Name, choose Markdown Field, and select Save & Configure.
A Markdown Field has the same two settings, Hint and Sanitize Html. The Standard editor is a plain text box, and the Wysiwyg editor option adds a toolbar. We keep Standard and select Save.

chapters.title: Youtube Field
chapters.subtitle: A video address becomes an embedded player

steps.text: The last field is the video. Enter Teaser Video as the Display Name, choose Youtube Field, and select Save & Configure.
Placeholder shows sample text in the empty box, and Hint adds help text. Width and Height set the size of the video box. Select Save.
The Workshop type lists all four fields, each with its field type.
In the Content Types list, select Create New Workshop. The editor shows the Title and our four fields.
Enter Pottery Basics as the Title. For the Registration Link, enter the address and the link text. The Target is already filled in from the field settings.
The Schedule is a rich text editor. Type the days and times, and use the toolbar to format them.
What to Bring takes Markdown. A line that starts with number signs becomes a heading, and lines that start with hyphens become a list.
For the Teaser Video, enter the address of a video page. The field builds the embedded address itself when the item is saved.
Publish saves the Workshop and makes it live on the site.
Back in the Content Types list, select List Items on the Workshop row. In the row of Pottery Basics, View opens the published Workshop on the site.
The Registration Link is an ordinary link with the words we typed. Because of the Target, it opens in a new window or tab.
The Schedule keeps the formatting that we applied in the toolbar.
What to Bring shows the Markdown as a heading and a list.
The Teaser Video appears in an embedded player, at the width and height from the field settings.

chapters.title: Safe by default
chapters.subtitle: How Html and Markdown are displayed

steps.text: The Html Field and the Markdown Field have a Sanitize Html setting, which is on by default. When the content is displayed, unsafe markup, such as script tags, is removed. What you typed stays stored as written.
By default, HTML that you type inside Markdown is shown as text, not as markup. And the Link Field rejects an address that isn't valid.
The Link Field, the Html Field, the Markdown Field, and the Youtube Field bring addresses, formatted text, and video into your content. Thanks for watching.
